name: Okuhikari
parentage: Yabukita x a native Shizuoka Zairai
description: 'Late Light'. A late-budding cultivar with a refreshing, brisk mouthfeel and a distinct floral and woody character that sets it apart from the more common vegetal or umami-driven Senchas. It is a versatile and reliable cultivar for farmers.
plantType: Vigorous, late-budding bush (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Its late budding makes it a useful cultivar for extending the spring harvest season and avoiding frost. It is adaptable to various climates.
processing: Okuhikari is typically processed as a standard Sencha (Chumushi) to maintain the balance of its unique flavor profile.
oxidation: Zero oxidation. The leaves are steamed immediately after harvest.
roasting: A standard light final drying roast is applied to stabilize the tea and round out its flavors.
versatility: Specialized for Sencha. It offers a unique flavor profile that adds diversity to the world of Sencha.

Sencha.Refreshing Sencha: Its primary use is to produce a Sencha with a unique, brisk, and slightly woody-floral character.

sensory.flavor: Brisk, clean, and refreshing with a pleasant sweetness and a distinct character.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Smooth, light-to-medium-bodied with a very clean and uplifting finish. The liquor is a clear, bright green-yellow.
